name: Village of Croton-on-Hudson
gaps: WDD (code: Waterfront Development WD District, § 230-22) is tract-based (10+ acres of dry land); per-lot setbacks are only 20 ft from streets and lot lines and 25 ft from mean high water
No minimum frontage set separately from lot width; no impervious-coverage limit for residence districts
Pool setbacks not found in Art. VII (pools count toward building coverage)
RB and RC districts each have separate rows for one-family and two-family/multiple dwellings; the district entry holds the one-family row and the other row is in notes
2026 local laws not yet codified (L.L. 9, 16, 17, 18 of 2026) were checked: they amend affordable housing, site plan review, property maintenance and cannabis provisions, not residential bulk

wetlands.summary: Ch. 227: permit for regulated activities in wetlands, watercourses and the wetlands buffer, which extends 120 ft from the wetland boundary or top of a watercourse bank (§ 227-3).

steep_slopes.summary: Ch. 195: steep slope permit for regulated activities on slopes of 15%+ with a 10 ft minimum horizontal dimension (15-25% moderately, 25-35% very, 35%+ extremely steep).

trees.summary: Ch. 208 Art. II (2025): permit to remove more than 3 trees in 12 months; any tree 8 in.+ DBH on subdividable, vacant or site-plan parcels; 4 in.+ on slopes over 20% or in a wetland/watercourse buffer; landmark and protected-species trees.

stormwater.summary: Ch. 196 Art. I: SWPPP for land development activities; routine maintenance and landscaping disturbing under 5,000 sf are exempt.

adu.summary: § 230-41: one accessory apartment (in a single-family house) or accessory cottage per lot with Planning Board approval; owner-occupied; 300 sf min and max the lesser of 800 sf or (for an apartment) 40% of the dwelling's habitable floor area; cottages 10 ft from all lot lines, max 15 ft high; village-wide cap of 50 permits.

general.accessory_structures: Accessory buildings may sit in required side/rear yards if max 15 ft high and 5 ft from any lot line, together using max 30% of the required side and rear yards; none nearer the street than the principal building (§ 230-40A-B).
general.pools: Pools count toward building coverage (§ 230-4); setback rules not found.
general.notes: Indian Brook-Croton Gorge Watershed Protection Overlay (Art. IVB) and Gateway Overlay (Art. IVA) add rules in mapped areas. Height of one- and two-family houses measured from average finished grade, which may not be raised more than 4 ft above preconstruction grade (§ 230-4).

RA-60.name: One-Family Residence RA-60

max_building_coverage.note: Building coverage: all principal and accessory buildings, including decks and swimming pools (§ 230-4)

max_floor_area.note: Residential FAR counts habitable floor area (excludes garages, cellars, utility rooms, unheated porches; includes habitable basements and attic space with 7.5 ft clear over 50%); FAR x actual lot area for over/undersized lots (§ 230-33B, § 230-4)

accessory.notes: Accessory buildings may sit in required side/rear yards: max 15 ft high, 5 ft from any lot line, together max 30% of the required side and rear yards; not nearer the street than the principal building (§ 230-40A-B)

RA-60.source: § 230-33A; 230 Attachment C, Area and Bulk Schedule (Supp 141, Dec 2023)
RA-60.notes: Min habitable floor area 1,400 sf (880 sf main floor). Corner lots need front yards on both street frontages (§ 230-40C(2)); corner_side_ft = front yard.

WDD.name: Waterfront Development (WD) District

max_building_coverage.note: Building footprints, % of the tract's dry-land area

WDD.source: § 230-22I Waterfront Development (WD) District bulk, height and parking requirements
WDD.notes: Tract district: min 10 contiguous dry acres with 1,000 ft of Hudson shoreline (min_lot_sf = 10 acres). Single-family, two-family and multifamily dwellings permitted; 1 market-rate unit per 5,000 sf dry land; structures 20 ft from streets and lot lines unless the Planning Board allows less, 25 ft from mean high water; within 75 ft of mean high water max 2 stories/25 ft; buildings 40 ft apart; 20% open space; min 750 sf per unit.
